B. Is this measure already running in North Karelia wellbeing services county (or in the KYS university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital. Every patient whose cancer has not spread (stage I-III) is discussed by video with the university hospital lung team (surgeon, radiotherapy doctor, oncologist) before anyone decides against treatment that aims to cure. Today a county hospital can decide alone.
effect_summary_en: A single English before-after study (62 patients in one year) found the yearly resection rate rose by 30% after video MDT meetings with a thoracic surgeon began; it did not measure the curative-treatment share.
supported_en: A 2004 study in the Journal of Telemedicine and Telecare reports a 30% relative rise in the yearly resection rate at one English district hospital after video MDT meetings began.
not_supported_en: No page shows the assumed gain of 1.5 points in the curative-treatment share, or any effect in a Finnish setting.
in_use_quote: Myös Joensuusta osallistutaan etänä useisiin MDT-kokouksiin ja lisäksi molemmissa keskussairaaloissa kokoontuu useita syöpäkohtaisia MDT-ryhmiä.

in_use_source.title: Kehittämisiltapäivästä vahvistusta moniammatillisten syöpätiimien yhteistyöhön – FICAN

missing_en: No page says that Joensuu's remote MDT links include the KYS lung meeting, or that every stage I–III patient is discussed there before curative treatment is ruled out.
summary_en: FICAN reports that doctors in Joensuu take part remotely in several KYS MDT meetings, but its page does not say whether the lung meeting is one of them. The KYS lung cancer care-pathway document says that every lung cancer patient is discussed at least once at its weekly meeting, where a thoracic surgeon and an oncologist are present; the document does not say whether this covers North Karelia patients. On the effect, one small English before-after study reports a 30% relative rise in the resection rate, which is consistent with the model's assumption but does not prove its size.
unanswered_en: No page says whether North Karelia's stage I–III lung cancer patients are routinely discussed at the KYS lung MDT.
